symptom: Studio Pro rewrote mxcli-made units on first open: an empty Security$ModuleSecurity.ModuleRoles stored with marker 1 and a Microflows$JavaScriptActionCallAction.ParameterMappings stored with marker 3, where Studio Pro writes 3 and 2. check, exec and mx check passed; only the git diff after opening showed it.
cause: ModuleRoles was registered as marker 1 on the reading that it is a by-name role list; it holds the roles themselves. The JS mapping child type was never registered, so it fell back to the encoder default 3.
insight: **A list's marker follows what it holds, not what it is called**: ModuleRoles is 1 on UserRole (names) and 3 on ModuleSecurity (parts). Settle a marker with a census of a Studio Pro-made project (owner $Type.key -> marker counts), never by analogy. Register it per owner/key too, so canon.NormalizeListMarkers corrects the units an older mxcli already stored on their next write.
